# Security Policy

This repository is a setup guide with small example scripts. It does not ship CLIProxyAPI itself.

## Reporting a problem in this guide

If a step in this guide could expose keys, OAuth tokens or a server to the internet, please report it privately through **Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository when that option is available. Otherwise open an issue without including any key, token, address or account name.

There is no guaranteed response time. This is a personal, best-effort project.

## Problems in CLIProxyAPI

Report vulnerabilities in CLIProxyAPI itself to the upstream project: https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI
